properties.headline: Môreson applies to rezone portions of its property for group housing development
properties.summary: Rezoning/subdivision of RE Erf 7173 (Môreson Child & Youth Care Centre) for 37 group-housing units (2 storeys, 127 bays); land to be sold to a developer to fund the centre. Neighbours object; Nel & De Kock Town Planners act for Môreson.
properties.place: Môreson, Petunia St area (Kat River), George
properties.developer: Môreson (owner) – Nel & De Kock Town Planners; buyer/developer not yet named
properties.map_link: Erf 7173 (same application already on the map)

properties.headline: Forever homes in sight for 61 Hornlee families
properties.summary: Knysna handed over 61 plot-to-plan sites on Erf 3339 (Fisherhaven/Rykmanshoogte/Hornlee); beneficiaries may now draw up building plans, deposits due 1 Oct–31 Dec.

properties.headline: Safe space plan for George's homeless
properties.summary: Working committee (municipality, Cremhog, business chamber, SAPS) prioritises a central low-entry overnight safe space and a first-contact service point; a CID, rehab centre and elderly sub-economic housing are longer-term ideas. No site chosen yet.
properties.developer: Cremhog / George Municipality working committee; possible new NPO or CID

properties.headline: Tyremart Commercial is in town! New name, same trusted team
properties.summary: Tyres & Treads Group rebrands its 22 Pioneer Road branch and says plans are under way for a new Tyremart outlet at the Garden Route Mall.

properties.headline: Eden House: From dream to reality
properties.summary: NPC has raised the full R2.75m to buy a property for Eden House, a planned registered children's home in Knysna; the home still has to be set up. Update 16 Oct 2026 (Knysna-Plett Herald): September brought progress on the building plans, new partnerships and fundraising; an unexpected property-transfer problem has delayed the project (founder Hilde Hay).

properties.headline: Concern over impact of multi-storey flats next to Blue Mountain
properties.summary: GRRA public meeting on Century Property Developments' bid to rezone Erf 28005 (5.7ha, Park Rd/Platinum Dr) from Business I to General Residential IV for ±680 rental flats in 18 three-/four-storey blocks; building line moved to 20m; still in public participation.
properties.place: Behind Builders Warehouse, Park Rd / Platinum Dr, George
properties.map_link: Erf 28005 (same application already on the map)

properties.headline: Controversial Building Control By-law repealed
properties.summary: Council repealed the 2023 Building Control By-law (25 Aug); a new by-law will drop minor works from plan approval, add simplified "Category 1" low-income/backyard buildings and align occupancy certificates with the NBR. Public engagement to follow.

properties.headline: George water security under pressure as population grows
properties.summary: No blanket moratorium on major developments, but larger developments must carry enforceable water demand management plans (efficient fittings, metering, rainwater tanks, indigenous landscaping). Treatment capacity now ~60 Ml/day.

properties.headline: Plattner Boulevard's first phase complete, with more upgrades to come
properties.summary: Phase 1 rehabilitation reopened 5 Sep; phase 2 (Barkhuizen Dr–Victor Smith Cres) depends on funding, phase 3 (to York St) needs access/capacity issues solved first.

properties.headline: Council considers impact of labour costs on IUDG-funded projects
properties.summary: Special council (28 Sep) adopted the 2026/27 Consolidated Capital Expenditure Framework that ranks infrastructure priorities for IUDG funding; PA wage proposal debated. Projects still need annual budget approval. (George Herald covered it 29 Sep.)

properties.headline: GO GEORGE activates trial route to airport
properties.summary: Route 19 Airport trial (CBD transport hub to George Airport via MediClinic) started 20 Sep, 05:00–20:00 daily; more stops may follow. (George Herald covered it 22 Sep.)

properties.headline: R26m boost for Garden Route disaster repairs
properties.summary: Municipal Disaster Response Grant: George gets R5m, mainly for the Haarlem Dam–Uniondale main water line; 6 months to spend.
properties.map_link: Related to (not the same as) the Uniondale water-network item (Erf 354)

properties.headline: Drone survey planned for Wilderness Beach as part of coastal dune rehabilitation plan
properties.summary: Baseline drone survey (15 Sep) for a coastal dune rehabilitation and maintenance management plan for part of Wilderness Beach; may affect future beachfront works.

properties.headline: Is Swartvlei for sale?
properties.summary: GRDM plans to sell Portion 0 of Farm 185 (Swartvlei Beach property, expected R15.9m) and RE Erf 1297 Kleinkrantz/Wilderness (R30m, SANParks talks); Save Our Sedgefield is pursuing legal remedies.
properties.erf: Portion 0 of Farm 185; RE Erf 1297 Wilderness

properties.headline: Aalwyndal: Development deadlock
properties.summary: 600ha Aalwyndal urban-expansion area (SDF 2018/2022) is stalled: council deferred the draft biodiversity/offset study; landowners want to be consulted.

properties.headline: Serious structural concerns for current Kwa station
properties.summary: KwaNonqaba police station failed a health inspection; a land exchange (17 Aug) between Mossel Bay Municipality and Public Works is the first step towards a long-awaited new station.
properties.developer: National Department of Public Works / SAPS

properties.headline: South Cape College partnership brings TVET plans to Knysna
properties.summary: Knysna Municipality, with South Cape College, has earmarked municipal land in the heart of Knysna for a new TVET college; more details on the proposed development promised in the next edition. Watch: public education building, out of George, site and professional team not yet named.
properties.place: Knysna town centre (site not yet identified)

properties.headline: Raad trek streep deur Jurischpark-planne
properties.summary: Hessequa council on 29 Sep 2026 rejected the application by Dorpstraat Convenient Retail Investments (Edms.) Bpk. to acquire about 37 170 m² of Erf 2080 (Jurischpark, Riversdale) for a shopping centre with residential units, after strong public objection; the park stays as is. Watch: contested municipal land sale, out of George area.
properties.developer: Dorpstraat Convenient Retail Investments (Edms.) Bpk. (applicant; rejected)
properties.location_source: Nominatim: Riversdale, Western Cape (town, approximate; park not in OSM)

properties.headline: Wilderness boardwalk repairs await restart after procurement delay
properties.summary: SANParks (Garden Route National Park) has finalised procurement and issued a purchase order for repairs to the Waterside Boardwalk along the Touw River in Wilderness, but work has not resumed because the appointed service provider is still mobilising funds; no restart or completion date given. Refurbishment began 11 Nov 2025 and stalled in March after a timber supplier failed to deliver. Watch: public tourism infrastructure, George (Wilderness).
properties.location_source: Nominatim: Wilderness, Western Cape (village, approximate; boardwalk not in OSM)

properties.headline: George residents invited to waste management workshop
properties.summary: Public participation on the draft 4th Generation Western Cape Integrated Waste Management Plan 2027-2032, which also covers George's Gwaiing landfill site; workshop held Tue 6 Oct at Blanco Community Hall; draft plan open for comment for 30 days from 16 Sep 2026. Article notes residents' concerns about landfill leachate and the Gwaiing river. Watch: provincial waste policy/plan affecting George.
properties.place: Western Cape (provincial plan); Gwaiing landfill, George

properties.headline: Bosbokkamp: 'n Nuwe hoofstuk vir Stilbaai
properties.summary: Advertorial: Ambik Commercial (Edms.) Bpk. and Amana Eiendomme are acquiring the Bosbokkamp property from the NG Kerk Stilbaai to develop it over the long term; final layout and scope still subject to municipal, statutory, environmental and infrastructure processes; enquiries Wynand L. Olivier (Amana Eiendomme). Watch: early-stage private land development, out of George area (Hessequa); no erf, size or professional team named.
properties.location_source: Nominatim: Stilbaai, Western Cape (town, approximate; property not in OSM)

properties.headline: Seven Passes Road expected to open in March next year
properties.summary: Western Cape Department of Infrastructure R73.6m flood-repair project on about 10 km of the Seven Passes Road (George to Wilderness) plus district roads west of George and near Wittedrif: culvert replacements, three slips repaired with piling and concrete decks, seven reinforced-earth/gabion walls, larger drainage pipes, subsidence repairs and resurfacing. Road still closed; completion expected March 2027. Watch: provincial road infrastructure, George.
properties.place: Seven Passes Road, George to Wilderness
properties.location_source: Nominatim: Seven Passes Road, George (road, approximate)

properties.headline: Montagu Pass to remain closed as repairs stretch into 2027
properties.summary: R55.3m rehabilitation of the 17.1 km gravel Montagu Pass (George to Herold), closed since 2023 flooding, by the Western Cape Department of Infrastructure: drainage cleared, road repairs between km 3.5 and 10, five new culverts planned and the Malgas River crossing to be replaced; heritage character (1848 pass, restored 1847 Toll House) to be preserved. Completion expected June 2027. Watch: provincial road/heritage infrastructure, George.

properties.headline: Regional waste site phase 1 nears completion
properties.summary: Garden Route District Municipality regional waste management facility: Cell 1A 99% complete, leachate and contaminated-water dams 82%, roads, buildings and stormwater nearly done. It cannot accept waste until DFFE (positive Record of Decision) and DWS approvals are in. Article is tagged PetroSA; no exact site given. Relevant because George Municipality closed its own landfill on 16 Oct after it reached capacity. Watch: regional public infrastructure.
properties.place: Garden Route District (regional waste facility; site not named in article)

properties.headline: Need exists for an inpatient treatment facility, according to Sanca
properties.summary: Sanca Garden Route (director Denise de Beer) presented survey research (442 respondents, Nov 2024) calling for a state-subsidised inpatient substance-abuse treatment facility in George first, later Mossel Bay and Oudtshoorn. No site, funding or project team yet; earlier Mossel Bay attempts (Willem van Heerden Building, 2022) met resistance. Watch rather than prospect because it is only a recommendation so far; it could become a facility brief if funded.

properties.headline: Long-awaited Go George bus service to connect Uniondale and Haarlem to George
properties.summary: Western Cape Government and George Municipality launch a Go George route from Uniondale and Haarlem to central George on Fri 30 Oct 2026 (Mon, Wed, Fri and Sat; two 15-seater minibuses from 06:00; R110 single trip). Watch: public transport for the rural east of George, where two new subdivisions (Erf 364 Haarlem, Erf 1145 Uniondale) were also advertised this week.
properties.developer: Western Cape Government / George Municipality (Go George)

properties.headline: GRDM still to respond to SANParks Erf 1297 offer
properties.summary: Garden Route District Municipality is finalising its response to a R5m SANParks purchase offer for Erf 1297, the 30 ha Kleinkrantz (Wilderness) property once earmarked for a Waterleaf Properties housing/resort scheme (DFFE refused environmental authorisation in Dec 2025). The 21 Oct council agenda says two more valuation reports are awaited; the erf is on GRDM's list of 19 properties for sale (listed value R30m). Residents report degradation and illegal occupation. GRDM's auction of its other properties is held up by appeals over the auctioneer appointment. Watch: contested public land sale; follows the 9 Sep "Is Swartvlei for sale?" item.
properties.location_source: Nominatim: Kleinkrantz, Wilderness (suburb point, approximate; Erf 1297 Wilderness not found in George CITP layer 16)

properties.headline: Victoria Bay restaurant up for tender following lengthy legal battle
properties.summary: GRDM tender GRDM/15/26-27 (published 13 Oct) for a 9-year-11-month lease, upgrading/refurbishment and operation of the Victoria Bay restaurant on a portion of Farm 195 Kraaibosch, after the former tenant (Byxiscan (Pty) Ltd t/a Vikki's at the Beach) was evicted and vacated on 31 July. Compulsory briefing at the restaurant 10:00 Tue 27 Oct; tender closes 11:00 Wed 18 Nov. Watch rather than prospect because no operator is named yet; the winning bidder will have a refurbishment to carry out.
properties.place: Victoria Bay, George (portion of Farm 195 Kraaibosch)
properties.erf: Portion of Farm 195 Kraaibosch (portion not stated)
properties.developer: Garden Route District Municipality (lessor; operator to be appointed by tender)

properties.headline: N9/N12 road upgrade between George and Oudtshoorn on track for June 2028 completion
properties.summary: Western Cape Department of Infrastructure R227.2m upgrade of about 5 km of the N9/N12 between George and Oudtshoorn plus 2 km of Waboomskraal Road repairs (started Oct 2025): lanes widened 3.3 to 3.7 m, surfaced 2 m shoulders, realignment, an ~800 m retaining wall, drainage, guardrails and signs. Completion expected June 2028. Watch: provincial road infrastructure north of George.
properties.location_source: Nominatim: Waboomskraal Public Library, N9/N12, George (approximate; plain "Waboomskraal" geocodes to Witzenberg, rejected)

properties.headline: Group Editors demands urgent action at airport crossing
properties.summary: Group Editors (CEO Servaas de Kock, letter 13 Oct) asked the George and Garden Route District mayors to escalate the R102/R404 George Airport intersection to the Western Cape Government for a permanently funded fix, independent of the proposed George western bypass. Mayor Johnson is preparing a submission to the province; a four-way stop is being discussed. Watch: provincial road safety infrastructure.
properties.developer: Western Cape Government (requested); George Municipality / GRDM
properties.location_source: Nominatim: George Airport, R404 (approximate; intersection not geocoded separately)

properties.headline: GAC and JMC arrive in George
properties.summary: Advertorial: Kelston Motor Group has opened a GAC and JMC dealership at 3 Glaze Street, George, with a dedicated aftersales operation (workshop, parts and accessories) "planned". Watch rather than prospect: the showroom is already open and it is unclear whether the workshop needs new building or fit-out work.

properties.headline: 30 apartments in the middle of Knysna
properties.summary: Advertorial: Oysters & Pearls on Trotter Street, Knysna (ground broken Aug 2026) - 30 apartments on three residential storeys over street-level parking and business units; designed by Olivier Architects for Oysters and Pearls Property Developers; 79-161 m2 units priced R2.99m-R4.79m. Watch: out-of-area scheme that already has its architect; shows housing demand in Knysna town centre.
properties.developer: Oysters and Pearls Property Developers (architect: Olivier Architects)
